title: Win the QUEEN in one move

segments.say: White to move. One knight move wins the black queen. Can you find it?
segments.caption: Win the queen in 1 move

segments.say: Pause and look at where the king and queen are standing.
Knight to c7. Check! And it attacks the queen at the same time.
segments.caption: Knight c7, check!

segments.say: The king has to move. And the knight takes the queen.
segments.caption: Free queen

segments.say: This is called a royal fork. Did you find it? Comment how fast.
